verdicts.evidence: Commit ce1f3b48c rewrote the comment in useAccountsModalItems.ts to say it fires 'once per from-empty search session' and that this is intentional. The code was left as it was, and the author replied that all comments were addressed except no.5.
Commit 52b0950cc changed the shared.tsx condition to `isSimilar && address.startsWith('0x') && address.length >= 10`, which adds the missing length guard.
Commit ce1f3b48c added a module-level `EMPTY_SAFES` constant and passes `filteredAllSafes ?? EMPTY_SAFES` to useAllSafesGrouped, so the fallback is a stable reference.
The author said 'no.5 is not solved as they are not private contracts'. useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:23-24 still calls `actual._getMultiChainAccounts` and `actual._getSingleChainAccounts`.
Commit 3309d94ba ('gate filteredAllSafes on isQualifiedSafe directly') changed the early return to `if (!allSafes || !isQualifiedSafe) return allSafes`.

Commit ce1f3b48c added the test 'degrades a multi-chain safe to single-chain when one of its chains is in the workspace' to useAccountsModalItems.test.ts. It asserts the surviving item is a single-chain SafeItem on chain 100.
